comments.author: @RobertWalbroehl
comments.text: Hard for a company to pay the elevated rates and stay open. I would rather earn less and stay working thank to make a huge raise and have them company get rid of me. Its happened to me at the airlines. The union and company could not agree on anything and forced us out on strike. After 15 years I lost everything. Lost vacation, all my 1400hours of sick leave, all my stock, medical and income with stay at home mom and two babies. Not worth asking for the moon. The company in may experience will win and employees will always lose. That it from a guy that has been through it already.
